title: Audit: GC executor TOCTOU between IPFS write and pin registration
description:
Static review did not trace whether GC can run between put_raw() in transit/peering/pipeline.rs:180 and the subsequent pin registration or group log append. If GC fires in that window, a just-written article could be collected before it is pinned, causing a dangling CID in the group log.

Step 1 — Trace (read only, no code change):
Read retention/gc_executor.rs and retention/pin_client.rs together. Identify what lock or transaction boundary (if any) prevents GC from collecting a CID that has been put_raw() but not yet appended to the group log.

Step 2 — Outcome:
- If a window exists: file a P0 bug with the exact code path, then write a test using a mock IPFS store that triggers GC mid-pipeline and asserts the article is not lost.
- If no window exists: document the mechanism that prevents it (add a comment if it is non-obvious) and close this issue.

Do not write code before completing Step 1.
